criterion_mapping.notes: Wikidata sits in the graph-linking tier: it contributes identity links and context, not preservation criterion claims, so no mapping is configured. Claims already in the store are still exported.

sources.notes: Run after PRONOM: every record anchors on an asserted PUID and has nothing to attach to on its own. Drop a saved SPARQL JSON result in input/wikidata_sparql/ to run offline.
